describes: Interposed material the prose grammar's interposed* production recognises between modal_head and action (deontic.ebnf, modal_frame). Each entry is a fixed phrase (matched word-for-word at a token position, never by a compiled pattern) plus 'negating': whether the phrase itself carries the negation ('at no time' does; 'at any time' and 'under any circumstances' do not). Surrounding commas are structural delimiters the tokenizer emits and the parser consumes; they are not gazetteer data.
